From timeless literary classics to cutting-edge research materials, we provide the resources and environment you need to learn, explore, and achieve your full potential. Our Legacy When John Harris, a New Zealander, arrived at the University of Ibadan in 1948 to serve as the Pioneer Librarian, he described what he found as "a librarian's nightmare and a scene of book chaos." From this beginning, the Kenneth Dike Library has grown into one of Africa's premier academic libraries, with over 2 million printed volumes and more than 10 million digital resources. 59 Years of Excellence 4 Distinguished Leaders 250x Collection Growth Discover Full History 77 Years of Excellence From 10,000 to 2.5M+ resources Since 1965 Visit Us Library Hours Plan your visit with our current operating hours and special schedules Current Status Currently Open 01:25 PM 07031668993 Kenneth Dike Library University of Ibadan.
